title: Quantum Versus Classical Machine Learning for Neuropsychiatric Disorders: A Feature-Matched Multi-Cohort Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Resting-state functional connectivity is widely used in machine learning-based classification of neuropsychiatric disorders. Quantum machine learning models have been proposed for functional connectivity data, but few studies have evaluated them under leave-site-out validation or against matched classical models. We compared six quantum model families with classical ones using identical correlation-derived features across four public cohorts (4,308 subjects). Leave-site-out validation was used for the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE I), ADHD-200 (attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder), and REST-meta-MDD (major depressive disorder) cohorts, while the UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (UCLA-CNP) was evaluated using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. translated_title: 神经精神疾病的量子与经典机器学习对比：一项特征匹配的多队列评估
translated_abstract: 静息态功能连接被广泛应用于基于机器学习的神经精神疾病分类。尽管已有针对功能连接数据提出的量子机器学习模型，但很少有研究在留一站点验证条件下对这些模型进行评估，或将其与匹配的经典模型进行比较。我们使用完全相同的基于相关性导出的特征，在四个公开数据集（共4,308名受试者）上比较了六种量子模型家族与经典模型。对于自闭症脑成像数据交换（ABIDE I）、ADHD-200（注意缺陷/多动障碍）和REST-meta-MDD（重度抑郁症）数据集采用留一站点验证，而加州大学洛杉矶分校神经精神表型学联盟（UCLA-CNP）数据集则采用分层10折交叉验证进行评估。在所有四个数据集上，量子核与匹配的经典核在统计上无法区分，平均准确率差异在1.4个百分点以内。
tldr: 该研究在四个公开数据集共4,308名受试者上，通过特征匹配设计和留一站点验证，系统比较了六种量子机器学习模型与经典模型在神经精神疾病分类中的表现，发现量子核与匹配的经典核在统计上性能无显著差异。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compared six quantum machine learning model families against matched classical models for neuropsychiatric disorder classification across four public cohorts (4,308 subjects) using feature-matched designs and leave-site-out validation, finding the quantum kernel to be statistically indistinguishable from the matched classical kernel.
